title: so / such, too / enough
en:
so + adjective / adverb: It was so hot. He speaks so fast. such (a) + (adjective) + noun: It was such a hot day. They are such nice people. Often + that: It was so late that we took a taxi.

too + adjective = more than necessary (a problem): The report is too long. too much / too many + noun.

enough: adjective + enough — It isn't big enough. enough + noun — We don't have enough time. Also: too … to do, … enough to do.
ru: so + прилагательное (so hot), such (a) + существительное (such a hot day). too — слишком (проблема): too long, too much/many. enough — достаточно: big enough (после прилагательного), enough time (перед существительным).

boss.situation: Describe a difficult project: use so, such, too and enough at least once each.
samples: The project was so complex that we needed two extra months.
It was such a busy period for our team.
There were too many changes in the plan.
The deadline was too short to test everything.
